name: Advanced Disable Checkpoints
description: Better control when checkpoints should be disabled!

time.name: Time
time.description: How long into a level after which checkpoints should no longer be disabled.
time.enable-if-description: Enable time in the working mode first.

checkpoint-count.name: Checkpoint Count
checkpoint-count.description: How many checkpoints should be activated before they no longer get disabled.
checkpoint-count.enable-if-description: Enable checkpoint count in the working mode first.

notification.name: Show Notification
notification.description: Show a notification when checkpoints are disabled.

notification-time.name: Notification Time
notification-time.description: How long the notification should be shown for.
